evals.prompt: I sell premium single-origin coffee beans. Target: millennials who care about origin stories and sustainability. Brand name: Altitude Coffee.
evals.expected_output: A standalone HTML page with spirits-fragrance category tokens (warm earthy accent ~#C45D2A), scroll-pinned grid sections, spatial typography spelling out a manifesto-style phrase, grayscale imagery, GSAP animations, and a contact form wired to {{FORM_ENDPOINT}}.
expectations: Output is a single valid HTML file
Uses Tailwind CDN and GSAP CDN (no build step required)
Has an 8-column checkerboard grid layout with visible tile borders
All images use grayscale(100%) contrast(1.15) filter
Has at least 4 scroll-pinned sections with GSAP ScrollTrigger
Hero section has a non-scroll load animation
Text is scattered across individual grid tiles (one word per tile) for at least one phrase
Includes accent-colored tiles that are NOT the default pink (#FF2D8F)
Has a grain overlay div with fixed positioning
Contact section has dark background (#111111) with email form
Form action uses {{FORM_ENDPOINT}} placeholder
Navigation uses mix-blend-mode: difference
Copy is uppercase manifesto-style, not corporate sales language
Page title includes 'Altitude Coffee'

evals.prompt: I'm a luxury real estate agent in Miami. I want a page for a $4.2M waterfront penthouse at Azure Tower. Target: high-net-worth buyers, international investors.
evals.expected_output: A standalone HTML page with luxury-real-estate category tokens (sophisticated dark accent ~#0D1B2A), property showcase sections, spatial typography, grayscale imagery with scroll animations.
expectations: Output is a single valid HTML file
Uses Tailwind CDN and GSAP CDN
Has checkerboard grid layout with 8 columns
All images use grayscale filter
Has scroll-pinned sections with enter/exit choreography
Accent color is NOT the default pink - should be dark/sophisticated
Has a Card Grid section showing property features or rooms
Copy mentions the property or real estate context
Includes a contact/CTA section with form
Page title includes 'Azure Tower' or brand name

evals.prompt: I run a high-ticket fitness transformation coaching program called FORGE. 12-week program, $2,997. Target: men 30-45 who want to look and feel elite.
evals.expected_output: A standalone HTML page with premium-fitness tokens (intense accent ~#00E5FF), coaching-style sections with program cards, commanding copy voice.
expectations: Output is a single valid HTML file
Has checkerboard grid with spatial typography
Accent color suggests fitness/energy (not default pink)
Has a Card Grid section showing program tiers or features
Copy voice is intense and commanding, not soft
Hero phrase is short (3-5 words) and scattered across tiles
Has GSAP scroll animations on multiple sections
Contact section includes email form with {{FORM_ENDPOINT}}
Includes price or program details somewhere on the page
